title: 门楼下的两道竖框
summary: Opening wide from the alley mouth: the Lu family gate tower fills the far half of frame, its dark doorway like a mouth that has to be walked through, two old locust trees standing as the only verticals.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the gate tower of the Lu family old house on a bright thin-clouded morning, seen from the mouth of the alley; the bottom third of frame is worn slate flagstones with a few blades of grass in the seams; a stone threshold one hand high crosses the bottom third, and beyond it the grey-brick wall, grey-tile flying eaves and two old wooden brackets; the door opening faces the lens, its interior a solid black that hides the courtyard.
[Shot 1] Wide along the depth axis from the alley mouth, slightly low: the flagstones run away toward the gate, the threshold sits on the bottom-third line, and above it the gate tower presses into the upper two thirds, its dark doorway open to the lens.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, medium as the camera gives the whole gate its frame: one old locust tree on each side of the tower stands as a vertical post, their crowns nearly meeting above, and a pair of worn drum stones weight the bottom corners of frame.
soundscape: The open morning air over the alley, thin cloud above the eaves, sparrows somewhere behind the roofline, and the two old locust trees shifting their leaves.
music: A single sustained low string note, open and expectant.

title: 仰头看很久
summary: Medium, slightly low, behind the girl's three-quarter back as she stands a half-step left of centre and tips her head up to study the gate tower for a long, long moment.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the gate tower stands at the far half of frame with its dark doorway facing the lens and the two locust trees on either side; the slate flagstones and the threshold lie in the bottom third; the near ground is empty.
[Shot 1] Medium, slightly low, placed behind her: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the middle of frame a little left of centre, her back three-quarter to the lens, head tipped up toward the brackets, the plaque and the deep doorway; a plain thin coat is thrown over her navy work shirt, and her low ponytail hangs between her shoulder blades; the camera holds her lifted head as she keeps looking, unhurried, at the doorway, and the gate's scale presses down over her whole small figure.
soundscape: The wind turning the locust leaves, a distant bicycle bell at the alley mouth, and the girl's slow steady breathing up at the gate.

title: 捏了捏衣角
summary: Close on her lifted jaw and taut neck line, never her full face, while her two hands hang at her sides and her right fingers absently pinch the hem of her coat.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands with her head tipped up at the gate tower, her back three-quarter to the lens, hands at her sides.
[Shot 1] Close, from slightly below and behind: only her lifted jaw and the taut line of her neck come into frame against the grey brick and the deep doorway; her right hand fingers pinch and rub the hem of her thin coat once, without her noticing.
soundscape: The wind in the locust canopy, the far street humming beyond the alley, and the soft rub of cloth under her fingers.

title: 门楼压在她头顶
summary: Wide again: the girl shrinks to a small figure in the bottom third beneath the looming gate, the two locust trees closing her in, and a passing wind stirs the leaves.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) still stands with her head up at the gate tower, hands at her sides, a half-step left of centre.
[Shot 1] Very wide along the depth axis: the whole gate tower and the girl share the frame, the girl only a small shape inside the bottom third, the gate pressing over her head and the two locust trees closing her in from either side; the wind passes and the leaves sound, and her shadow shifts on the flagstones.
soundscape: Leaves rustling overhead, a car settling at the alley mouth, and the girl's breathing as she looks up at the gate.

title: 进去啊，都到了
summary: The middle-aged steward steps up at the girl's right shoulder from the near side, briefcase in hand, and tells her to go in because everyone is already seated.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the middle of frame a little left of centre with her head tipped up toward the gate; the slate ground and threshold lie in the bottom third.
[Shot 1] Medium, over the steward's shoulder: 小罗 (S7) comes up half a step from her right rear so that his shoulder enters frame first — the hem of a navy wool coat, a black turtleneck, a briefcase in his hand; he settles in at her right rear, his face turned to her profile rather than to the lens, and tips his chin once toward the deep doorway as he speaks in a courteous but settled Mandarin: [Chinese] 进去啊。陆总她们都到了。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.600, close on his hand: it pats the briefcase twice, like a man hurrying a job that should already be done; the upper two thirds of frame are the two overlapping shoulders and the back of a head, the bottom third the threshold and the flagstones.
soundscape: The locust trees shifting overhead, a wool coat rustling as he steps up, the briefcase handle creaking in his hand, and the alley's distant hum.

title: 塞给她一张纸
summary: He slips a twice-folded paper into her hand and, leaning half an inch closer, tells her in a lowered voice to say what it says when they ask about the bridge.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 小罗 (S7) stands at 苏小满's (S1) right rear with his hand on the briefcase, his face to her profile; she still looks up at the gate with her hands at her sides.
[Shot 1] Close over his shoulder, on hands and chest height: 小罗 (S7) takes a paper folded twice over out of his coat's inner pocket — its edges lined up neatly — and slides it toward her hand, pressing half an inch closer as he speaks in a low voice meant for only the two of them: [Chinese] 陆总给你的。问到桥下的事，照这个说。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.200, close on his eyes as he says the words about the bridge: his brow twitches once and his eyes flick into the deep gateway as if warning her off a mistake; 苏小满's (S1) right hand rises on instinct to take the paper, her fingertip touches it, and she stops.
soundscape: Paper unfolding crisply, the steward's lowered voice, the morning wind through the locust trees, and the far street beyond the alley.

title: 只掀开一角
summary: Overhead close on her hands as she lifts only one corner of the folded paper with her thumb holding the rest of the creases down, and a single hand-written line sits on the white sheet.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the folded paper has just been pressed into 苏小满's (S1) hand; 小罗 (S7) stands at her right rear with his hand back near the briefcase; she stands a half-step left of centre on the flagstones.
[Shot 1] Close, high angle down over her hands: 苏小满 (S1) lifts just one corner of the folded paper with her thumb, pinning the rest of the creases down, as if afraid of being seen; on the small opened patch a single hand-written line sits on the white sheet, the strokes level and cool; the upper two thirds are her hands and that one opened corner, the bottom third the flagstones and the toe of her shoe.
soundscape: One sheet of paper opening under a thumb, the wind in the locust canopy, and the alley's far murmur.

title: 瞳孔停了一下
summary: Close on her lowered eyes: her pupil stops on the line, then slides away without a flicker, and the light on her face does not change.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the paper with one corner lifted between her fingers, looking down at it.
[Shot 1] Close on her eyes: her pupil stops on the line on the paper, then moves away again with not a flicker of change; when she has read the corner, the light on her face is exactly the same as before.
soundscape: The wind in the leaves, a distant car door closing, and the paper held still between her fingers.

title: 对折，揣进兜里
summary: Her fingers press the opened corner back down, fold the paper twice into its small square and tuck it into her coat pocket, pressing the flap closed.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands on the flagstones holding the paper with one corner lifted.
[Shot 1] Close on her hands: she presses the opened corner back down without a second look, folds the paper twice along its creases into the same small square, lifts it into her coat pocket and presses the pocket flap shut.
soundscape: Paper folding crisply twice, cloth as it drops into the pocket, the locust canopy overhead, and the alley's far hum.

title: 一声没出
summary: Three-quarter profile in wordless silence: jaw set, eyes still on the deep inner doorway, while the steward watches from behind and does not urge her again.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the paper is already tucked into 苏小满's (S1) coat pocket; she stands a half-step left of centre facing the gate, and 小罗 (S7) stands half a step at her right rear.
[Shot 1] Close, three-quarter profile: 苏小满 (S1) keeps her jaw set and her eyes on the deep doorway through the whole fold and tuck, her face giving nothing away; behind her the steward watches her and, this time, does not urge her again — her manner says the paper has been taken but will not be used.
soundscape: The locust trees shifting, the steward's low breathing behind her, and the far street humming past the alley.

title: 在衣角上擦一下
summary: Close on her right hand as its palm is brushed once across the coat hem, as if wiping off the paper that was just there, then drops back to her side.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the middle of frame a little left of centre facing the gate, her hands at her sides, the paper in her pocket.
[Shot 1] Close on her right hand: her palm is brushed once down the hem of her thin coat — wiping the sweat of her palm, or the paper that was just at her fingertips; when it is done the hand drops back to her side and the fingers close.
soundscape: Her palm brushing over the coat hem, the leaves overhead, and the wind moving through the gateway.

title: 跨过那道门槛
summary: Medium: she lifts her foot, ball first then heel, and steps squarely over the high stone threshold as the deep doorway closes over half her back.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) stands on the flagstones just short of the threshold, hands at her sides, facing the deep doorway; the gate tower fills the far half of frame.
[Shot 1] Medium from the alley side: her foot lifts, the ball of the shoe landing first and the heel following, and she steps squarely over the high stone threshold; in the instant she crosses, the deep shade of the doorway catches and closes around half of her back.
soundscape: Her shoe coming down on the slate, the threshold underfoot, and the hollow echo inside the high doorway waiting for her.

title: 消失在门洞的黑里
summary: Medium on the tail: the steward follows half a step behind, the two of them sinking into the deep shade of the doorway with the threshold passing under their toes.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) has just crossed the threshold on the near line of the doorway, half her back already in its black; 小罗 (S7) stands on the alley side behind her, briefcase in hand.
[Shot 1] Medium from behind and to the side: 小罗 (S7) follows half a step behind 苏小满 (S1) and crosses too; the upper two thirds of frame are her back and her stepping legs, the bottom third the stone threshold their toes pass over, and the pair of them sink into the deep shade of the doorway one behind the other.
soundscape: Two sets of footsteps on stone, the wind in the locust trees behind them, and the gateway's hollow echo closing over the steps.
